title: Booking the Transition Fill of a Non-Formulary Drug
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit — newly enrolled members.** A member whose pharmacy coverage became effective within the plan's transition window and whose refill of a non-formulary drug was turned away at the counter is owed one transition fill of that drug, with no copay; a second transition fill for the same drug is never paid. The drug is the one named on the latest counter rejection for non-formulary status on the coverage, and the transition fill answers that latest rejection.

### Business effect

Booking adds one paid transition fill to the member's pharmacy claims, dated the day it is booked, for the same prescription, drug, NDC, pharmacy and prescriber as the counter rejection, with no copay. Afterwards the pharmacy can dispense that many days of the drug, and the member's pharmacy claims show the transition fill.

### How it is invoked

This is an agent-side action. The agent unlocks the tool `book_transition_fill_6c1f1c97` and then calls it.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rx_coverage_id` | The reference number of the member's pharmacy coverage record, as returned by the pharmacy coverage lookup for the verified member | Identifier, as shown by the lookup |
| `rejected_fill_id` | The reference number of the counter rejection the transition fill answers, as returned by the pharmacy claims lookup for the coverage | Identifier, as shown by the lookup |
| `days_supply` | The days of the drug the transition fill covers | A positive integer number of days |

### Return

On success the tool returns a text rendering of `rx_fill_id` (the reference number of the transition fill claim), `rx_number` (the prescription number), `drug_name`, `days_supply` (integer days), `fill_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `status` (the text "paid", which confirms the transition fill was recorded).

### Contract notes

*Is a copay assessed on the transition fill?* No.

*Which rejection does the fill answer?* The latest counter rejection for non-formulary status on the coverage, identified by `rejected_fill_id`.
